# Prof. Christian Farioli

> AI keynote speaker, executive educator, author and Forbes México contributor. This is the official website for Christian's speaking topics, writing, event experience and enquiries.

Christian's work connects AI strategy with business decisions and human responsibility. His speaking page focuses on CEOs, leadership teams and corporate event organisers in Dubai, with enquiries also welcome for events worldwide. Keynote themes include AI strategy, Digital Employees and responsible delegation to AI.

## Speaking and event enquiries

- [AI Keynote Speaker in Dubai for CEOs and Leadership Teams](https://christianfarioli.com/ai-keynote-speaker-dubai/): Keynote topics, intended audience takeaways, the differences between keynotes and workshops, event highlights, testimonials and booking links.
- [Keynote topics](https://christianfarioli.com/ai-keynote-speaker-dubai/#topics): AI strategy for executive decisions; Digital Employees and the changing organisation; human judgement and accountability when delegating to AI.
- [Let's talk about your event](https://calendly.com/chrisfarioli/30min): The existing booking calendar for discussing the audience, event date, desired outcomes and suitable format.
- [WhatsApp enquiries](https://wa.me/971509596182): An alternative way to contact Christian about an event.

A keynote introduces a shared perspective and questions for discussion. A workshop gives a smaller group time to apply ideas to a defined challenge. A training programme supports sustained learning and practice. Scope, preparation and format are discussed for each audience.

## Insights

- [How to Choose an AI Keynote Speaker in Dubai: A Guide for CEOs and Event Organisers](https://christianfarioli.com/insights/ai-strategy/how-to-choose-an-ai-keynote-speaker-in-dubai/): An original buying guide covering audience outcomes, a proposed five-criterion speaker-selection scorecard, evidence to request and the choice between a keynote, working session or training programme. Christian discloses his interest as a speaker and invites readers to apply the criteria to him too.
- [All Insights](https://christianfarioli.com/insights/): Articles on AI, leadership, strategy and the future of work.
- [AI Strategy articles](https://christianfarioli.com/insights/category/ai-strategy/): Writing on AI strategy and executive decision-making.
- [Insights RSS feed](https://christianfarioli.com/insights/rss.xml): Recent published articles in a machine-readable feed.
